summary: Verified the last implicit link in the stale-vote reachability argument: a candidate that receives a leader's replicate message or heartbeat calls becomeFollower with that sender as leader before processing the message, which runs reset and rebuilds the vote tally — so the gate that refuses campaigning with unapplied commits plus this demotion keep a tally from spanning two configurations. Added the demotion source, revised the knowledge entry to cite it (revision 2), and appended the fully-cited account for the same question, keeping the out-of-band-event and transport bounds. No execution requested.
